name: terse
description: Mechanical prose checks and writing skills that keep the author's voice.

scripts.eval: claude plugin eval . --allow-tools Bash Write Edit --json evals/results/latest.json --max-cost-usd 10 --no-publish && node scripts/eval-score.mjs evals/results/latest.json
scripts.eval:quick: claude plugin eval . --allow-tools Bash Write Edit --runs 1 --case claudism-removal --json evals/results/latest.json --no-publish && node scripts/eval-score.mjs evals/results/latest.json
scripts.eval:fallback:quick: node scripts/eval-run.mjs --runs 1 --case claudism-removal && node scripts/eval-score.mjs evals/results/latest.json

author: Alastair Dawson
